description_en: Interrupts a call in a waiting node of a voice navigation flow and directs it to the next hop
description_zh: 如果当前通话在语音导航的等待节点，通过此接口可以打断等待，执行到下一跳
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-interrupt-ivr --enterprise-id 7000002 --unique-id 123456789 --user-field '{}' --check-name name1 --check-value value1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudInterruptIvr

parameters.help_en: The unique call identifier, which also serves as the unique channel identifier
parameters.help_zh: 通话唯一标识；从通道唯一标识
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: A custom field, provided as a JSON string
parameters.name: user_field

parameters.help_en: The name of the channel variable to check
parameters.help_zh: 根据变量名去通道变量中取对应的变量值
parameters.name: check_name

parameters.help_en: The value to compare with the channel variable specified in `CheckName`. The interruption is triggered only if the values match
parameters.help_zh: 当checkName代表的变量值与checkValue一致，才打断
parameters.name: check_value
